scope: three-item continuous-time stationary periodic joint replenishment with independent rational frequency caps

candidate_theorems.name: finite_second_pair_complexity_enumeration
candidate_theorems.statement: Primitive triples with second-smallest reduced pair complexity at most S form a finite set generated by the declared construction.

candidate_theorems.name: three_item_tail
candidate_theorems.statement: Every omitted triple has cost at least sqrt((S-1)/(S+1)) times the minimum one-pair/desynchronised boundary value.

candidate_theorems.name: exact_cap_oracle_totality
candidate_theorems.statement: For K0>0 and positive holding costs, the exact independent-cap three-item oracle terminates after a finite cutoff.

candidate_theorems.name: fixed_item_monotonicity
candidate_theorems.statement: Gamma_(n+1,box) is at least Gamma_(n,box), so the three-item lower bound propagates to every fixed n at least 3.

candidate_theorems.name: holding_box_vertex_principle
candidate_theorems.statement: If one cap-bound fixed schedule is globally optimal at all vertices of a holding-cost box, it is globally optimal throughout that box.
